title: nnU-Net Deep Learning Method for Segmenting Parenchyma and Determining Liver Volume From Computed Tomography Images.
summary: nnU-Net trained on LiTS and IRCAD CT images; test volume estimates compared with manual ground truth. Specific liver segmentation/volume result on small public datasets; clinical transplantation utility remains proposed.
